name: 44805 · Ashland, OH
findings: ZIP 44805 (Ashland) has 177 nonprofit organizations. 86 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 72 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44805 (Ashland) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 44805 (Ashland) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).
